findings.explanation: You must perform additional services requested by the client during the term without receiving any extra pay, creating significant unpaid workload.
findings.suggested_change: Any additional services requested by the Client shall be agreed upon in a written change order and billed at the Contractor's standard rates.

findings.quoted_text: Client may request unlimited revisions until Client is fully satisfied with each Deliverable.
findings.explanation: The client can demand endless rounds of revisions without any limit until they are fully satisfied.
findings.suggested_change: The Client may request up to two rounds of revisions per Deliverable, and any further revisions shall be performed at the Contractor's standard hourly rates.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would like to propose a few adjustments: - Regarding the relevant clause requiring additional services at no charge, this creates an unpaid workload, so I propose that any additional services be agreed upon in a written change order and billed at standard rates. - Regarding the clause concerning unlimited revisions, this creates an open-ended obligation, so I propose that the agreement allow up to two rounds of revisions per deliverable with further revisions billed at standard hourly rates. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards,
